name: vibe-coding-experts
description: Experts for the vibe-coding-workflow: architecture, maintainability, security, QA

plugins.name: frontend-backend-architect
plugins.description: Defines full-stack R&D infrastructure: monorepo layout, global unique schema, frontend/backend templates, reusable skills, and quality gates so AI agents code with complete organizational context.

plugins.name: maintainability-reviewer
plugins.description: Audits code against the design doc's maintainability discipline (separation of concerns, single source of truth, file organization, PR granularity) and flags agent-loop concept leakage.

plugins.name: security-expert
plugins.description: Application security expert focused on the Jev 'security & data boundary' dimension: audits data exposure, authorization bypass, injection, and boundary validation, and delivers actionable hardening steps.

plugins.name: qa-expert
plugins.description: QA expert who designs real-environment regression paths and behavior-correctness verification, covering browser-agent E2E regression, performance capture, and the Jev 'behavioral correctness' dimension.
